reviewScope.summary: Add a repository-scoped Copilot custom agent profile; no application or workflow changes.
evidence: Read AGENTS.md, docs/CURRENT_STATE.md, docs/ci.md, the copy-lane classifier and current GitHub custom-agent configuration documentation.
Fetched the agent profile after creation and reviewed the owner-directed revision removing arbitrary testing and editorial blockers. No product, dependency or provider changes were made.
Computed the candidate payload tree from the GitHub Git tree after removing docs/release-reviews. Hosted release checks and Copilot UI discovery have not yet been observed.

adversarialFindings.description: An agent profile could contradict current product boundaries or bypass exact-candidate validation and owner-controlled release decisions.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Direct the agent to current repository instructions, preserve local-first and authorized provider contracts, and retain existing release controls and explicit authorization boundaries.

adversarialFindings.description: A custom agent could introduce unnecessary testing, duplicate implementation, or stale generated-content changes.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Require one agent, risk-based checks only, no prose-only tests or editorial blockers, existing canonical exporters and reuse of hosted results.

retrospective.summary: Scoped implementer review found no material unresolved issue in the profile. Existing hosted validation remains required before integration; agent discovery is not yet verified.
